RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.what: The power sentence C-20 makes MANDATORY on every downstream record is FALSE. It says a 5 per cent shortfall of T would very likely go undetected.
RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.why_false: At T-18-3-B16, T/sem_001 = 124.73, so a 5 per cent shortfall has expected |z_sem| = 6.24 and CR-1 fires with probability about 0.999.
RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.independently_confirmed_by_the_dispatchi: 124.73 at T-18-3-B16 giving 6.24 at phi = 0.05, with the next tuple at exactly 3.00 - which is the COUNT the power curve's column was reporting.
RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.origin: The curve's column reports a COUNT of tuples reaching 3.000 and three sessions read it as a MAGNITUDE. This is the cardinality-not-identity failure PRED-ID exists to prevent, recurring a THIRD time in the same contract, inside its own power curve.
RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.who_it_passed: All three pre-execution reviews called the sentence correct.
RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.adoption: Both ledger records carry the sentence VERBATIM and the correction VERBATIM beside it, with an explicit rule that neither may be quoted without the other.

RT21_1_the_blocking_adoption_finding.the_true_bounded_picture: Detection about 0.9999 at a 5 per cent shortfall and 0.99 at 4 per cent; blind below about 1.5 per cent and to any shortfall not proportional to T. Likelihood ratios against phi = 0: 1.5 at 0.02, 5.7 at 0.03, 87 at 0.04, about 8600 at 0.05 - resting essentially on three tuples.
